summary: Preserve exact ProcessIR inspection and refuse retired live staging.
details: The live capture entry point now refuses its retired mod-directory staging before reading engine or archive inputs or creating run output. Offline reference checking remains available. Current native capture requires conversion to the configured master library; this release does not deliver that conversion.

Retained capture controls use tiny checkout-local files and a substituted engine actor. They permit no normal native staging and establish no new gameplay or release acceptance. Historical ProcessIR records remain unchanged.
